Reference

Core replacement matrix

A package can take the place of a core plugin with "replaces". The replacement must then keep what other plugins and the user already depend on. This page lists, for each replaceable core plugin, the surface items its replacement must provide, the stored data it must leave alone, the CLI names it must keep, the settings tabs and commands that disappear while the built-in plugin is off, and the install error codes that a wrong replacement gets.

Requirement ids of this page are DEV-846 to DEV-849. The rules of replacement itself are in Extending core plugins, and the worked example is tutorial 21. The complete list of core points is in Core extension points.

You need

  • The rules of Extending core plugins: the surface check, one replacement at a time, and what happens on uninstall.
  • The tutorial 21 for a complete replacement of ilium.core.titles.
  • The page of each plugin in the matrix, which is linked from its row.

Which plugins are in the matrix

The matrix has one row for each core plugin whose page says **Replaceable:** yes. There are 28 rows. Two core plugins are not replaceable and have no row: ilium.core.sessions and ilium.core.settings. A package that lists either one in replaces fails with manifest.replaces-not-replaceable.

How to read a row

  • Surface items are the names that a replacement must provide, written as kind:name: points: for extension points, services: for services, topics: for published topics, commands: for commands, pane-kinds: for pane kinds and cli: for CLI commands. The names are the ones after the plugin id, so services:suggest means ilium.core.titles/suggest. The kinds are the ones that replaces checks (reference manifest).
  • Stored data to leave alone lists the config tables of the plugin's Settings tabs, the snapshot sections and the storage keys that its page names. A replacement MUST NOT read or write them ([DEV-847]). Where a page names no stored key, the cell says none named.
  • CLI names to keep lists the ilium subcommands that the plugin owns, as they appear in the CLI compatibility page.
  • Lost while off lists the Settings tabs, commands, pane kinds and routes that disappear while the built-in plugin is off. The stored data stays on disk and the replacement does not read it.
  • Install error codes names the code that a missing surface item gives. The other codes of the replacement check are shared by every row and are listed below the matrix.

The matrix

Plugin Surface items to provide Stored data to leave alone CLI names to keep Lost while off Install error codes
Agent detection ilium.core.agent-detect points:activity-rules, points:classify, services:state, topics:state-changed Config tables [ui] and [detection] (tab Agent Monitoring) none Tab Agent Monitoring manifest.replaces-surface-incomplete
Agent setup ilium.core.agent-setup points:instruction-blocks, points:targets, points:before-install, services:install, commands:refresh Config table [agent_setup]; instruction blocks in the agent files, marked <!-- ilium-agent-feature: ... --> none Tab Setup; command refresh manifest.replaces-surface-incomplete
Agent toolbar ilium.core.agent-toolbar points:toolbar-actions, points:banner-segments, services:last-prompt, commands:compact, commands:history none named none Commands compact and history; the toolbar actions manifest.replaces-surface-incomplete

Chatroom ilium.core.chatroom points:before-post, points:message-renderers, services:post, services:tail, topics:posted CHATROOM.md at the project root; hook text in the agent files chat (init, send, context, tail) none manifest.replaces-surface-incomplete
Compaction ilium.core.compaction points:techniques, points:before-compact, services:compact, topics:finished, commands:compact Config tables [remote_compaction] (tab Remote compaction); the agent config files settings.json and config.toml, which the plugin never writes none Tabs Optimization and Remote compaction; command compact manifest.replaces-surface-incomplete
Cost ilium.core.cost points:price-sources, points:quota-sources, services:usage, topics:usage-changed Config tables [cost] and [reset_planning]; project storage keys day/<day> none Tabs Agent Cost and Reset planning manifest.replaces-surface-incomplete

Fleet ilium.core.fleet points:selectors, points:before-broadcast, services:broadcast, services:panes, topics:broadcast-sent, commands:ask-for-update Config table [api] (tab API) panes, broadcast, new-pane Tab API; command ask-for-update manifest.replaces-surface-incomplete
Inference providers ilium.core.inference points:before-request, points:after-response, points:provider-profiles, services:complete, topics:request-finished Config tables [inference], [inference.instructions] and [voice] none Tabs Inference and LLM Instructions manifest.replaces-surface-incomplete
Kanban ilium.core.kanban points:card-actions, points:card-moved, services:boards, services:set-setting, topics:card-moved, pane-kinds:board Config table [kanban_board] none Tab Kanban Board; pane kind board manifest.replaces-surface-incomplete
Keys and help ilium.core.keys-and-help points:key-hints, points:help-sources, services:bindings, topics:changed, commands:show-keys, commands:show-plugins Config tables [keyboard] and [keybindings] none Commands show-keys and show-plugins; section Plugin keys in tab Keyboard manifest.replaces-surface-incomplete
Layout ilium.core.layout points:layout-presets, points:before-split, services:presets, topics:changed none named none none named. Layout is essential, so it cannot be turned off, but it can be replaced manifest.replaces-surface-incomplete
Notifications ilium.core.notifications points:before-notify, points:channels, services:notify, topics:raised Config tables [sound] and [notifications]; plugin storage key muted none Tab Sound manifest.replaces-surface-incomplete
Progress ilium.core.progress points:footer-segments, points:probe-kinds, services:report, topics:changed none named progress (alias wait) Route GET /progress.json, which the plugin answers manifest.replaces-surface-incomplete

Scenes ilium.core.scenes points:scene-packs, points:scene-data-sources, services:catalog none named none none named manifest.replaces-surface-incomplete
Scheduler ilium.core.scheduler points:schedule-sources, points:before-send-scheduled, services:queue, topics:fired Snapshot section ilium.core.scheduler with scheduled_input and prompt_queue per pane none none named manifest.replaces-surface-incomplete
Workspace search ilium.core.search points:sources, points:rank, services:query, commands:open none named none Command open and its keybinding manifest.replaces-surface-incomplete
Session conversion ilium.core.session-convert points:formats, points:after-convert, services:convert, commands:convert Session storage key convert/<pane id> none Command convert; its context menu entry manifest.replaces-surface-incomplete
Smart copy ilium.core.smart-copy points:recognisers, points:after-copy, topics:copied, commands:smart-copy none named none Command smart-copy; its context menu entry manifest.replaces-surface-incomplete
Terminal ilium.core.terminal points:before-send-input, points:open-link, points:link-actions, services:transfer, topics:screen-changed Config table [terminal] none Tab Terminal manifest.replaces-surface-incomplete
Text triggers ilium.core.text-triggers services:test-rule, points:rule-packs, points:before-fire, topics:fired Config table [text_triggers] (tab Text Triggers) none Tab Text Triggers, output rules on every agent pane manifest.replaces-surface-incomplete
Titles and organisation ilium.core.titles points:before-apply-title, points:title-styles, services:suggest, topics:title-applied Config tables [inference] (tab Titles) and [triggers] (tab Triggers) none Tabs Titles and Triggers; the tree-tidy action and the preview panel (tutorial 21) manifest.replaces-surface-incomplete
Tree ilium.core.tree points:before-move, points:before-close, points:node-sorts, services:bookmarks, topics:changed none named none none named. Tree is essential, so it cannot be turned off manifest.replaces-surface-incomplete
Voice ilium.core.voice points:transcript, points:voice-intents, services:say, topics:heard, commands:voice.toggle Config table [voice] (tab Voice control) voice Tab Voice control; command voice.toggle manifest.replaces-surface-incomplete
Worktrees ilium.core.worktrees points:before-create, points:post-create-steps, points:before-remove, services:create, services:remove, topics:changed, commands:new-agent Config table [git] (tab Git) none Tab Git; command new-agent manifest.replaces-surface-incomplete

Install error codes

Every replacement is checked with the same codes, whichever row it replaces. The surface row above names the one that a missing item gives.

Code When it is given
manifest.replaces-unknown The id is not a core plugin.
manifest.replaces-not-replaceable The id is ilium.core.sessions or ilium.core.settings.
manifest.replaces-surface-incomplete A surface item of the row is missing. The error lists every missing item.
manifest.replaces-cycle Two packages replace each other.
manifest.replaces-tier The package is neither bundled nor trusted, so it may not replace a core plugin (Extension security, SEC-301).
manifest.schema The list has more than 4 ids, or a duplicate id.

Requirements

  • [DEV-846] A replacement of a core plugin in the matrix MUST provide every surface item of its row, with the same names, and each point and service MUST keep the same kind and the same major version as the plugin it replaces. A replacement that misses an item MUST fail at install with manifest.replaces-surface-incomplete, and the error MUST list each missing item.
  • [DEV-847] A replacement MUST NOT read, write or delete the config tables, snapshot sections and storage keys named in its row. Its stored data MUST stay on disk unchanged when the built-in plugin comes back.
  • [DEV-848] A replacement MUST keep every CLI name listed in its row. Each name MUST give the arguments, output and exit codes of the CLI reference, so that ilium chat context --since-last-read and the other names used by scripts and agent hooks keep working.
  • [DEV-849] The matrix MUST have one row for each core plugin whose page says **Replaceable:** yes, and for no other plugin. Each row MUST match the points, services, topics, commands and pane kinds of that page.

Open decisions

  1. Requirement ids DEV-850 and DEV-851 are already in use. They belong to the performance requirements of Performance and are registered in the dev tooling register. This page uses only DEV-846 to DEV-849. Choice: keep the assigned range and use four ids. Consequence: if the owner needs six ids, the two extra ids must come from DEV-854 onward, outside the range that was assigned.
  2. Most core manifests do not declare a surface. Reference manifest and PKG-029 say that a replaceable core plugin carries a surface list. Only 6 of the 28 core pages show one. Choice: the rows are derived from each page's complete manifest and from its services and topics lists. Consequence: if the core manifests are changed to declare a surface, every row must be checked against that declaration, and any difference is a defect in this page.
  3. Most pages name no stored key. Where a page names no storage key or snapshot key, the cell says none named. Choice: list only what the pages name. Consequence: a replacement may still touch data that no page names. A complete list needs the storage keys from the plugin code.
  4. Kanban tab id differs. The manifest of Kanban names the settings tab kanban, while its kernel tab table names kanban-board. Choice: the row uses kanban-board, the id of the kernel tab. Consequence: a check that looks for the tab kanban will not find the tab that is lost while the plugin is off.
  5. Two plugins share the config table [inference]. The Titles tab and the Inference tab both name [inference] in their kernel tab tables. Choice: both are listed as stored data. Consequence: a replacement of one plugin must not change the keys that the other one reads, and the owner of each key needs to be stated on the kernel page.
  6. Titles commands are not in the manifest. The core Titles manifest declares no command, but tutorial 21 says the tree-tidy action goes away with the plugin. Choice: the row follows the tutorial. Consequence: if the manifest is the reference, the tree-tidy action drops out of the row.
  7. Command compact is declared twice. Agent toolbar and Compaction both declare it. Choice: both rows list it. Consequence: replacing one of them leaves the other one answering compact. This page does not decide which owner keeps the name.
  8. The install code list is not the same in two places. Extending core plugins lists four codes. The manifest schema also lists manifest.replaces-tier. Choice: this page lists five codes and manifest.schema. Consequence: a reader who copies only the four-code list will not expect the tier refusal.

  • Core extension points for the points, services and topics of every core plugin.
